terminus.title: Terminus
terminus.definition: A station where one or more scheduled Southeastern passenger services regularly originate or terminate.

interchange.title: Interchange
interchange.definition: A station identified as an interchange on the Southeastern network map. This includes major London terminals where passengers can conveniently change between Southeastern routes or connect with other rail, Underground, DLR, Elizabeth Line or Tram services.

high_speed.title: High Speed 1
high_speed.definition: A station where scheduled Southeastern Highspeed services call.
